<@84562395988508672> (or anyone from pandas): I keep getting errors once per 1-3 hours on devnet 11 on different grandine nodes indicating problem between snooper and different ELs, e.g.:

```
grandine-geth-1:

ERRO[2026-09-15T05:49:12Z] call failed: proxy response stream error: read tcp [2400:6180:100:d0:0:1:8a14:300d]:50732->[2400:6180:100:d0:0:1:8a14:300e]:8551: use of closed network connection 
2026/09/15 05:49:12 http: superfluous response.WriteHeader call from github.com/urfave/negroni.(*responseWriter).WriteHeader (response_writer.go:53)

grandine-reth-2:

ERRO[2026-09-15T06:37:00Z] call failed: proxy response stream error: read tcp 172.18.0.6:53260->172.18.0.5:8551: use of closed network connection 
2026/09/15 06:37:00 http: superfluous response.WriteHeader call from github.com/urfave/negroni.(*responseWriter).WriteHeader (response_writer.go:53)
WARN[2026-09-15T06:37:00Z] failed unmarshaling data: unexpected end of JSON input 
```

Is this a known problem? Should I create an issue on ethpandaops/rpc-snooper?
